title: Topic
description: Adds a live topic: contract (defineTopic), registrations and a spec that checks the topic is bounded, keyed and secret-free.

name.description: The topic id, namespace.name (for example tap.messages).

module.description: The service module that owns the topic (svc-tap or tap). It must exist: create it with the service-module generator.

flow.description: credit sends data frames against the credit the UI grants; snapshot-delta sends a snapshot, then deltas that remove items by key.

qos.description: lossless is never dropped (a gap and a snapshot on overflow); latest is coalesced by key at --max-hz; sampled keeps every n-th item with counters and needs the credit flow.

permission.description: The permission from the RBAC catalogue (blueprint 7.3), area.verb.

maxHz.description: Frames per second at most. Required for qos latest.
